per_patch_deadline_policy: one shared deadline per bad-face component covers block-LP retries and single-node fallbacks; later components receive a fresh slice until the global deadline

joint_small_patch_fallback.eligibility: only after a failed block LP and zero accepted one-node fallback; 2-4 movable corners of 1-4 current bad seed cells
joint_small_patch_fallback.deadline: reserved slice remains inside the same per-patch deadline; full star and exact Float32 local gates before ledger acceptance

trust_policy: bounded local patches; per-point cumulative L1 measured from immutable baseline across all accepted patches
